manifesto.title: THE BURNEPEP MANIFESTO
paragraphs: BURNEPEP is not just a meme. It’s a new perspective. We flip the ordinary, burn the stale, and turn chaos into something brighter.
A community that refuses to take things seriously, but takes freedom, creativity and culture seriously.
manifesto.aside: NOT A MEME. A NEW BEGINNING.

token.title: TOKEN HIGHLIGHTS
token.tagline: MORE THAN A TOKEN. A CULTURE.

cards.title: MEME CULTURE
cards.body: Born from internet culture. Powered by creativity. For the degenerates, dreamers and difference makers.

cards.title: COMMUNITY ENERGY
cards.body: A global community that flips perspectives, creates together and burns the boring.

cards.title: BURN MECHANIC
cards.body: Deflationary by design. We burn, we build, we go higher. Less supply. A brighter tomorrow.

cards.title: VISUAL IDENTITY
cards.body: An iconic character. A unique style. Recognizable. Unmistakable. BURNEPEP.

community.title: COMMUNITY
community.body: BURNEPEP lives through its community. Artists, creators, holders and dreamers from around the world, all flipping the same narrative. Different perspectives. One movement.
